settings.name: Green Apple
settings.desc: First-bite Granny Smith snap. Bright, tart, and a little mischievous on the finish.

settings.name: Mojito
settings.desc: Lime, mint, and bubbles doing their thing. Zero rum. All breeze.

settings.name: Watermelon
settings.desc: Like the first slice on the first warm day. Ripe, juicy, no faking.

settings.title: Real Fruit
settings.desc: Built around real fruit, not a flavor packet. Tastes like the fruit on the can.

settings.title: Just 9g Sugar
settings.desc: A fraction of a regular soda's 39g — lightly sweetened with real cane sugar.

settings.title: Nothing Artificial
settings.desc: No artificial colors, sweeteners, or mystery additives. Caffeine-free, too.

settings.title: Recyclable Can
settings.desc: Aluminum is infinitely recyclable. We picked the can that comes back.

settings.text: "Finally a soda that tastes like actual green apple — not a candy version of it. And I don't get the sugar crash. Obsessed."
settings.author: Maya R.

settings.text: "The Mojito is so refreshing it replaced my afternoon soda habit. 9g of sugar and it still tastes like a treat."
settings.author: Jordan P.

settings.text: "Watermelon tastes like the real slice, not a popsicle. Whole family drinks it — and I feel fine giving it to the kids."
settings.author: Dana L.
